title: Thunder Bay 36 boreal wildfire, Ontario
location: Wabakimi, northwestern Ontario. Ignited 12 July 2026, about 319,000 ha, Ontario's largest fire on record
description: The pixel classes show mostly wind on lakes: a boreal burn moves L-band HH by about +1 dB per pixel because trunks and soil are left standing. Turn on Landscape 500 m and the burn stands out; the HLS photos from the same two days confirm it
